name: Funder report draft
summary: Before a funder report is due, the grants manager gets a draft written to the funder's own questions, with every number tied to a record, an index of the evidence behind each statement and a list of what is still unanswered. People verify it, approve it and submit it.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of nonprofit grants and reporting work, and its rules for prepared work: every number tied to a record, every gap written as a question for a named role, and a person who verifies, approves and submits.
